flow: parse explicit roots and required D59 source tuple
validate exact tuple fields and source object/tree identity
resolve fresh origin/main and pinned tuple tip for every selected repo
run all selected git merge-base --is-ancestor checks before writes
create private alternates-backed verifier views from resolved base/tip
squash/verify/bundle using the private pinned endpoint
render README, add guarded extras, write checksums, and optionally ZIP

tuple_authority.format: D68/D73-compatible plain object keyed by the four repo names
tuple_authority.agent_rule: Agent tip is item.agent.sha from the tuple; never resolve or fallback to local tl/integration
tuple_authority.identity_rule: root sha and root sha^{tree} must match the tuple exactly
tuple_authority.dirty_rule: every selected source root must be clean

caller_contract.preflight_failure: exit 2; exact repo/base/tip; no staging or export writes
